document_title: Process Transfer Plan — A-Mab Drug Substance
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
out_of_schema_notes: Transfer plan spans the whole process train; entities are the sites, the Step 3-10 process steps and the CQAs preserved across the transfer.
The distinctive objects are the TransferGap entries (transfer_has_gap assertions); each gap is anchored twice, on its §8 narrative statement and on its row of the gap table.

Strictly prospective: the document reports no characterization outcome, so the annex carries no parameter classification, no capability and no design space. The only counts asserted are the prospective study-type allocation (multivariate / univariate).

inventory.rationale: Title block declares document class 'Process Transfer Plan'.

statements.statement_text: PTP-001 governs the transfer of the A-Mab drug-substance manufacturing process from the sending development site to the receiving commercial drug-substance site.

source_references.quote: This plan governs the transfer of the A-Mab drug substance manufacturing process

statements.statement_text: PTP-001 is the parent document of the A-Mab process characterization package: RA-001, PCMP-001, the per-step plans and reports and PCMR-001 all derive from it.

source_references.quote: This plan is the parent document of the A-Mab process characterization package

statements.statement_text: Each plan in the package commits a study and each report records what that study found, and the set exists to justify the operating ranges and the control strategy the receiving site will run.

source_references.quote: each report records what that study found, and the set as a whole exists to justify the operating ranges and the control strategy that the receiving site will run

statements.statement_text: The transfer covers the manufacturing process, the analytical methods that test the intermediates and the drug substance, and the control strategy that connects the two.

source_references.quote: The transfer covers the manufacturing process, the analytical methods that test the intermediates and the drug substance, and the control strategy that connects the two

statements.statement_text: The plan governs the transfer of the A-Mab drug substance manufacturing process from the development site to the commercial manufacturing site.

source_references.quote: This plan governs the transfer of the A-Mab drug substance manufacturing process from the development site to the commercial manufacturing site

statements.statement_text: The characterization scope table gives, per unit operation, how many parameters enter the campaign and how the study type splits between multivariate and univariate work.

source_references.quote: how many parameters enter the campaign, how the study type splits between multivariate and univariate work

statements.statement_text: Parameter classification is not established until PCMR-001 is approved, so the master batch record cannot be finalized before then.

source_references.quote: Parameter classification is not established until PCMR-001 is approved

statements.statement_text: Gaps were identified by comparing what the receiving site holds today against what the qualification campaign requires, and a gap must be closed before the campaign starts or its residual risk assessed and accepted under the quality system.

source_references.quote: A gap must be closed before the qualification campaign starts, or its residual risk must be assessed and accepted under the quality system

statements.statement_text: Characterization is the Stage 1 process design work of the validation lifecycle and process performance qualification is Stage 2, which follows this transfer.

source_references.quote: Characterization is the Stage 1 process design work of that lifecycle, and process performance qualification is Stage 2

transfer_gaps.description: The scale-down models are qualified against the development train only, so every characterization conclusion reaches commercial scale through the model rather than through a commercial batch.
transfer_gaps.impact: Characterization conclusions reach commercial scale only through the model.
transfer_gaps.mitigation: Qualify each model against the receiving-site equipment train and record the comparison in the characterization plan for the step; owned by MSAT at the sending site.

source_references.quote: The first two gaps set the schedule, because each requires laboratory work at a site that has not yet performed it

source_references.quote: Scale-down models are qualified against the development train only

transfer_gaps.description: The validated analytical methods are not qualified at the receiving site.
transfer_gaps.impact: Comparability results and in-process results cannot be generated or interpreted at the receiving site.
transfer_gaps.mitigation: Transfer and requalify every method under a written protocol; owned by Analytical Development.

source_references.quote: neither can be closed by a document review

source_references.quote: Analytical methods are not qualified at the receiving site

transfer_gaps.description: Harvest and clarification and the ultrafiltration and diafiltration step carry no multivariate design, so their operating ranges rest on univariate work and platform experience.
transfer_gaps.impact: Operating ranges for these two steps rest on univariate work and platform experience.
transfer_gaps.mitigation: State the limitation in PCP-004 and PCP-010 and support the ranges with univariate data and prior knowledge; owned by MSAT at the sending site.

source_references.quote: The gap on harvest and UF/DF will still be open when the campaign ends, because no multivariate design is planned for either step at any point in the programme

transfer_gaps.description: Parameter classification is not established until PCMR-001 is approved, so the master batch record cannot be finalized before then.
transfer_gaps.impact: The master batch record cannot be finalized.
transfer_gaps.mitigation: Draft the batch record after PCMR-001 is approved and run engineering batches against the process description; owned by MSAT at the receiving site.

transfer_gaps.impact: Buffer hold time and stability are not covered by development data.
transfer_gaps.mitigation: Qualify buffer hold times at the receiving site before the engineering batches; owned by MSAT at the receiving site.
